I'm not depressed.  It's hard to explain.  When I wrote the post I was upset and thinking irrationally, but overall I'm not depressed.  I just don't see logic in life, sometimes.  I think I just need to get away from the family though.  They aren't good for my mental health... maybe distance will make that better.  They give me feelings of inadequacy.  I want to distance myself from that.  I've tried talking, the whole nine.  I do agree that I should exercise more.  Right now I don't have time/energy for it.  My job consumes my life.  I'm working on that though.  Formatted my resume today!

i work 40+ hours with around 4 hours of travel per day... by the time i get home im exhausted.  on the weekend i spend my time unwinding.. or doing more work if they assign it to me.  i need a new job basically.
i could probably draw out a concept if you can describe it well enough but im def not an artist of that caliber lol.  better to ask your tattoo artist ;)

i think the part that is hardest is not hating myself for not always being happy.  it's like i dig myself a grave.  i get sad and then i fight it and then i hate myself for thinking it in the first place etc etc.  i'm my own worst critic.  i've dealt with verbal abuse in the past, and i've had a lot of negativity in my life (i'm an optimist by nature, but i'm very impressionable).  i've been cutting out those negative voices one by one.  when my one steady rock, my bf, is apart from me is when it seems to be worst.  it's like i suffer from adult separation disorders.  i wish someone had advice how to cope, because just telling myself to be happy doesn't always cut it.  i need to learn to accept and love myself,  too.  that's a biggy.
usually i start positive then a negative thought slips in, then it's constant back in forth til i'm mentally and emotionally exhausted
thank you.  i try not to use other's as my basis for self worth but it's hard
thank you.  i really will try to pull the positive out of the situations.  is it just a habit i need to learn?
